summary: Build policy briefs, evidence matrices, and dashboards in 5 days. Learn evidence-based policy making methods you can apply immediately.
lede: Policy analysis and monitoring help professionals working with policy documents, programme data or governance processes turn evidence into decisions and track results. Training covers defining policy problems and baselines, appraising evidence, comparing options, and shaping implementation plans and indicators. Participants practise tools such as problem trees, evidence appraisal matrices, stakeholder maps and policy dashboards to prepare briefs and report progress.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who already work with policy documents, programme data, consultation inputs, or governance processes and need a more disciplined way to turn evidence into decisions.
prerequisites: You should bring a laptop for working on templates, matrices, and dashboard exercises. A current policy issue, a sample briefing note, or a monitoring report from your own work will help you complete the applied exercises faster.
